sn28.2:1.2: addasā kho āyasmā ānando …pe… āyasmantaṃ sārīputtaṃ etadavoca
sn28.2:1.3: vippasannāni kho te āvuso sārīputta indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto
sn28.2:2.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn28.2:2.2: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso na evaṃ hoti
sn28.2:2.3: ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ dutiyā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
sn28.2:2.4: tathā hi panāyasmato sārīputtassa dīgharattaṃ ahaṅkāramamaṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatā
sn28.2:2.5: tasmā āyasmato sārīputtassa na evaṃ hoti
sn28.2:2.6: ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjāmīti vā ahaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannoti vā ahaṃ dutiyā jhānā vuṭṭhitoti vāti.
